chunks: And Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام said:
"If you keep company with someone, then keep company with your equal, and do not accompany one who suffices you entirely, for that is a humiliation for the believer."

key_terms.نَحْوَكَ: your equal or one similar to you in standing
key_terms.يَكْفِيكَ: takes care of your needs or suffices you

ai.seo_question: Why did Imam Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام discourage accompanying someone who completely takes care of one's needs?
ai.summary: Imam Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام teaches the believer to preserve dignity in companionship by traveling or associating with social equals. Relying completely on another in such a way that one loses independence is described as a form of humiliation for the believer.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "If you travel with someone, travel with your equals, and do not accompany someone who takes care of your needs entirely, for that is a humiliation for the believer."
